name: Model Fitting (Fine-tuning)
aliases: Test-Time Finetuning with Optimized Latent Code
definition: Adapts the weights of the prior model for generating novel views of a target identity at high resolutions by finetuning from sparse views.
summary: Model fitting adapts a pretrained volumetric prior to generate high-resolution novel views from sparse inputs by jointly optimizing model weights and a per-identity latent code.
